title: AssetMeta
description: An asset sidecar (§6.4): an asset meta (Importer, ImporterVersion, Settings, SubAssets) or a dependency meta (Owner).

Format.description: The file's format name; first key of the file.

Version.description: The format version this build writes; older versions are migrated when read.

Handle.description: The asset's handle: 16 hex digits, unique in the project.

Type.description: The asset's main type, or "Dependency" for a file a glTF references.

Importer.description: The importer that cooks the source (asset metas only).

ImporterVersion.description: The version of that importer when it last wrote the meta (asset metas only).

Settings.description: The importer's settings object (its *ImportSettings struct; asset.getImportSettings shows the schema), or null.

SubAssets.description: The sub-assets the source produces, sorted by Key (asset metas only).

Key.description: The stable identity of the sub-asset in its source (kind, index, name), such as "mesh:0:Straight".

Handle.description: The sub-asset's handle: Hash64 of the source handle and the key.

Owner.description: The handle of the glTF that references this file (dependency metas only).
